notes: Exhaustive sieve over all k: every n in (1, 2*10^10] with sigma_inf(n) = k n is divisible by 3; the 15 such n are exactly the A007358 terms below 2*10^10, so that list is complete there. Elementary structure of a 3-free counterexample: n even; if 3 does not divide k, every prime = 2 mod 3 (including 2) has even exponent; if 3 | k, v_3(k) = sum of v_3(1+p) over primes p = 2 mod 3 with odd exponent. Outside Lean: the sieve computation (C, 128-bit exact sigma_inf) and the one-line remarks.

sources.what: k = 2 exhaustive below 10^28, all divisible by 3
